newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chuang's China to place 130 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Chuang's China to place 130 mln shares.

text.p: Chuang's China Investments Ltd said on Thursday its controlling shareholder Rourke Investments Ltd had agreed to place 130 million existing shares, or 8.3 percent of the existing share capital, at HK$0.20 per share before subscribing 260 million new shares at the same price.
Chuang's China said net proceeds of HK$51.7 million from the subscription would be used to fund property development projects in China and for general corporate purposes.

The electronic products maker and property concern said Rourke had agreed to place the shares with Thakral Investments Ltd, a company controlled by the Singapore-based Thakral family which controls Thakral Corp Ltd
Upon completion of the placement on October 4, Thakral's stake in Chuang's China will be increased to 9.8 percent from 3.1 percent, the statement said.
Rourke's stake in the company will be diluted to 66 percent from 68.7 percent.
Chuang's China shares were last traded at HK$0.215 prior to their suspension on Wednesday. Trading will resume on Thursday.
